headline: Davanagere recorded 2,422 severely malnourished children under age 5 by December 2011, with malnutrition concentrated in certain taluks.
summary: By December 2011, Davanagere district had 2,422 children under 5 suffering from severe malnutrition, with 83 moderately malnourished. Chennagiri taluk had the highest burden (529 cases), followed by Harapanahalli (458) and Harihar (430). The Department of Women and Child Development launched awareness programs, provided nutritious food through anganwadi centers, and conducted health check-ups with treatment at Bapuji Hospital. A pilot study demonstrated that protein-rich Davanagere Mix (groundnuts and Bengal gram flour) effectively treated malnutrition. Child marriage prevention efforts succeeded in stopping 25 of 26 cases in April-May 2024.
